papers.title: Delayed Effects of Temporary Weight Decay in Muon Pretraining
papers.brief: 研究在Mu​​on训练的解码器模型中施加临时权重衰减，比较不同窗口的最终效果；通过范数动力学、固定范数重放与范数重置实验，检验延迟收益的机制。
papers.tldr: 临时权重衰减可在撤除时损害模型，却通过持久范数变化改善最终预训练效果。
papers.what_it_is: 研究在Mu​​on训练的解码器模型中施加临时权重衰减，比较不同窗口的最终效果；通过范数动力学、固定范数重放与范数重置实验，检验延迟收益的机制。
key_points: 覆盖162M、405M、1.4B和3.4B参数模型
跨规模迁移方案在训练73%后反超，最终改善0.028 nats
范数重置实验表明，较小权重范数解释大部分最终收益
papers.why_notable: 揭示优化干预结束时的损失可能误导方案选择；短期衰减通过持续改变相对步长产生长期收益，评估应对齐最终训练预算。
papers.abstract: A temporary optimization intervention can increase validation loss when it ends yet reduce it at the final training budget. We demonstrate this with temporary weight decay in Muon-trained decoder-only Transformers with 162M, 405M, 1.4B, and 3.4B parameters. For models up to 1.4B parameters, moving a fixed-duration decay window from early to late training reverses its final effect. At 162M, changing window duration alters final loss even at approximately matched total shrinkage. Most strikingly, a schedule selected at 162M and transferred without retuning to 1.4B is 0.26 nats worse than no decay when removed, overtakes it only after 73% of training, and ultimately finishes 0.028 nats better while also outperforming the best sampled constant-decay baseline. Early decay leaves a persistent weight-norm deficit, which keeps relative steps larger after the intervention ends. An approximate norm-dynamics recurrence captures the slow convergence of these relative steps, and fixed-norm replays of the measured trajectories reproduce the performance ordering and a similar loss difference. At 162M and 405M, norm-reset experiments show that smaller weight norms at the end of the decay window explain most of the final loss improvement. A separate Gram intervention exhibits related post-removal norm and relative-step dynamics. These results show that temporary optimization schedules can have delayed effects long after removal and should therefore be evaluated at the intended final training budget, not only at removal.

papers.what_it_is: 构建专业工作簿任务基准，让智能体在容器内调用表格工具完成请求。评判智能体直接检查文件，按专家制定的二元标准逐项验收。

papers.abstract: We introduce GDP_xlsx, a benchmark of 70 realistic workplace requests written by professionals in 13 domains, each paired with an expert rubric of binary criteria and with the complete workbook or CSV file it refers to. Together the files hold 2.18 million populated cells, and the rubrics 791 criteria. Agents work in a container with spreadsheet tools, and an agentic judge that can open the file applies the rubric. Completeness and exclusivity criteria require set-valued answers to be found in full and with nothing extra. We rank models by strict pass@1, the share of attempts that meet every criterion. Across 20 model configurations, including frontier models from Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, the top-scoring one, Gemini 4 Argon, passes only 38.3% of attempts, and the median score is 19.3%, leaving wide headroom. We release the evaluation harness and three public tasks; the other 67 are held out to protect the leaderboard from contamination.

papers.title: LuthorSQL: A One-Pass Text-to-SQL Model as System 1 for a Slower LLM Agent
papers.brief: 提出非自回归的7B模型，以单次前向预测受限语法中的槽位分数，执行候选查询并用验证器选答案；低置信度问题再交给慢速大模型智能体。
papers.tldr: 用本地单次前向模型分流数据库查询，在保持智能体准确率时降低调用成本。
papers.what_it_is: 提出非自回归的7B模型，以单次前向预测受限语法中的槽位分数，执行候选查询并用验证器选答案；低置信度问题再交给慢速大模型智能体。
key_points: 单次前向生成最多32个候选计划，训练验证器选答案
BIRD执行准确率68.03%，单GPU每题0.84秒
227题级联实验近半本地回答，同准确率成本降33.3%
papers.why_notable: 把快速本地模型与高精度智能体结合，展示了不牺牲准确率的成本优化路径；训练截止后数据库测试也增强了结果可信度。
papers.abstract: Frontier LLM agents that query databases with tools are among the most accurate text-to-SQL systems, but per-query calls to a hosted model are slow, costly, and expose sensitive organizational queries to external APIs. For example, a Claude Opus 5.5 agent serving 10,000 queries a day costs over $70,000 a year at list price. To what extent can local hardware already owned by an organization offload this burden without compromising the agent's accuracy? We present LuthorSQL, a non-autoregressive 7B text-to-SQL model that serves as a rapid System 1 gate for a slower LLM agent (System 2), escalating queries only when uncertain. LuthorSQL makes a single forward pass to predict slot scores over a bounded grammar for query plans, compiles and runs up to 32 candidate plans, and chooses an answer using a trained validator. On its own, LuthorSQL reaches 68.03% execution accuracy on BIRD's hidden test set at 0.84 s per question on a single GPU, maintains its accuracy in 9 GB with 8-bit quantized weights, and transfers zero-shot to Snowflake, BigQuery, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and DuckDB within 3.1 points of its native SQLite accuracy. Combined with Claude Opus 5.5 in a pre-registered confidence cascade over 227 questions on databases published after Opus's training cutoff, LuthorSQL answers nearly half of all questions locally and cuts API cost by 33.3% at the same accuracy. Finally, contamination probing shows that Opus reproduces 48-92% of public benchmark gold queries verbatim without seeing the schema; however, its tool-assisted accuracy holds on renamed schemas and reaches 95.6-97.4% on post-cutoff databases. Code and data: https://github.com/IAMIbrahimmemon/luthorsql

papers.title: Logically Consistent Accurate Forecasts
papers.brief: 研究用微调的监督语言模型校正相关事件的概率预测。模型利用各项预测背后的推理，联合消解逻辑矛盾，而非直接将概率投影到一致集合。
papers.tldr: 微调监督语言模型利用预测推理，同时提升事件概率预测的准确性与逻辑一致性。
papers.what_it_is: 研究用微调的监督语言模型校正相关事件的概率预测。模型利用各项预测背后的推理，联合消解逻辑矛盾，而非直接将概率投影到一致集合。
key_points: 微调监督语言模型，依据预测推理联合校正概率
ForecastBench上Brier分数改善9.3%
结构性不一致降低82—90%，基线未能兼顾两项目标
papers.why_notable: 它表明概率一致性与预测准确性不必相互牺牲，为语言模型预测系统提供了更可靠的校正路径，有助于提高决策可用性。
papers.abstract: Agentic forecasting systems based on large language models (LLMs) are now competitive with expert human forecasters, but these systems still suffer from a critical limitation: the inability to produce forecasts that are logically consistent. For example, forecasts for related events often fail to satisfy the axioms of probability, which in turn implies that related forecasts cannot simultaneously be correct and undermines their utility for decision makers. Enforcing consistency is not trivial -- naive approaches (e.g., projection onto the set of consistent forecasts) can degrade accuracy. We argue that the key to overcoming the apparent tradeoff between consistency and accuracy lies in the reasoning which supports each forecast. We finetune a supervisory language model that leverages this reasoning to jointly reconcile inconsistencies while improving the accuracy of related forecasts. On ForecastBench, our method improves the Brier score of a retrieval-augmented GPT-5.1 forecaster by 9.3% while reducing measures of structural inconsistency by 82-90%. We interrogate our method via a comprehensive series of baselines and ablations, and find that no alternative method matches our gains in consistency and accuracy simultaneously.

papers.title: AutoRL: A Multi-Agent System towards Autonomous Reinforcement Learning
papers.brief: AutoRL将感知、提案和编排角色嵌入持续进行的强化学习训练。系统监测异常与停滞，协同诊断问题，再通过在线热更新或检查点恢复执行调整。

papers.what_it_is: AutoRL将感知、提案和编排角色嵌入持续进行的强化学习训练。系统监测异常与停滞，协同诊断问题，再通过在线热更新或检查点恢复执行调整。

三个Proposers共享证据，诊断并完善干预方案
在Qwen3与LongCat-Flash-Lite上优于静态配方及通用智能体
papers.why_notable: 将自动化研究从完整实验推进到训练过程中的持续干预，展示无人值守强化学习调优的可行性，为递归自我改进提供训练基础。
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) is one of the most promising paths toward an AI singularity for superintelligence. Achieving this vision requires AI systems to undertake the full training pipeline for iterative improvement. Reinforcement learning (RL) plays an essential role in this cycle to improve model capabilities and generalization, yet automating RL remains difficult due to unstable training dynamics and the need for sustained supervision. We introduce AutoRL, a multi-agent system for automating RL training, as a cornerstone for future RSI. Different from conducting research by end-to-end complete experiments, AutoRL monitors the evolving training state and integrates process-level supervision and research into an ongoing RL training, following the practical workflow of an RL researcher. Specifically, AutoRL consists of three RL-specific agentic roles. Perceptors track training dynamics, rollouts, evaluation, and efficiency, triggering deliberation when they detect anomalies, degradation, or stagnation. Three complementary Proposers diagnose problems and refine candidate interventions through shared evidence and checks. The Orchestrator reviews their recommendation and applies approved changes through online hot updates or checkpoint-based resumption. Experiments on Qwen3 and LongCat-Flash-Lite demonstrate the superiority of AutoRL over static RL recipes and a general agent. The research records show that existing agents can handle unattended RL supervision and dynamic adjustment. The difficulty for future RSI lies in developing fundamental methods that are valuable for resource-consuming validation.

papers.brief: CarryOn将紧凑执行状态与细粒度、可追溯证据配对，通过学习式选择器和自适应保留策略管理上下文，无需额外调用大模型。

papers.what_it_is: CarryOn将紧凑执行状态与细粒度、可追溯证据配对，通过学习式选择器和自适应保留策略管理上下文，无需额外调用大模型。

papers.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents can coordinate tools and applications to complete complex, multi-step tasks. As their interaction histories grow, effective context management becomes essential for reliable and efficient execution. Existing methods reduce context through summarization, pruning, or history selection. However, shorter contexts do not necessarily support better decisions: summaries can omit exact details needed for later actions, while retaining entire interactions can carry substantial irrelevant information. We propose CarryOn, a lightweight context manager that pairs compact execution state with fine-grained, source-linked evidence. A learned selector and adaptive retention policy keep relevant evidence available without additional LLM calls for context management. We introduce two complementary evaluation metrics: $S_α$ prioritizes task success while accounting for resource use, and normalized cost per success (NCS) measures the resources spent per successful task. Across AppWorld, OfficeBench, and Tau2 Telecom with three LLM Actors, CarryOn achieves 75.7% macro-averaged task success, exceeding the strongest baseline by 6.7 percentage points. It also achieves the best average scores on both metrics.

papers.title: Vision-as-a-Tool: Visual Harness for Multimodal Agentic Coding
papers.brief: 提出VaaT范式，将通用多模态大模型作为外部视觉工具，供编码智能体调用。以五种原子动作构建VHarness，支持纯文本智能体外包视觉推理、多模态智能体按需增强感知。
papers.tldr: 将视觉推理外包为可调用工具，让编码智能体突破自身感知能力限制。
papers.what_it_is: 提出VaaT范式，将通用多模态大模型作为外部视觉工具，供编码智能体调用。以五种原子动作构建VHarness，支持纯文本智能体外包视觉推理、多模态智能体按需增强感知。
key_points: VaaT将多模态大模型封装为可调用视觉工具
VHarness以五种原子动作统一视觉工具调用
在图像转HTML、SVG和3D任务中提升视觉与几何质量
papers.why_notable: 把视觉能力与编码智能体解耦，使纯文本模型也能参与视觉任务，并为多模态智能体提供可按需扩展的感知路径。
papers.abstract: Multimodal agentic coding requires robust visual reasoning to analyze observations and evaluate generated artifacts. Current frameworks largely rely on a Thinking-with-Images paradigm, where agents depend on their intrinsic vision to execute visually grounded tasks. However, this architectural coupling introduces a fundamental bottleneck. Agent performance remains strictly bounded by internal perceptual limitations. Furthermore, text-only agents lack native perception. Without specialized tools, they cannot perform visual reasoning. To overcome these constraints, we introduce the Vision-as-a-Tool (VaaT) paradigm. Prior visual tool-use merely manipulates images for an agent's intrinsic vision to read. In contrast, VaaT reframes general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as callable external utilities. As a result, text-only agents can completely offload visual reasoning during agentic execution. Meanwhile, vision-capable agents can dynamically augment their native perception on demand. We instantiate this paradigm in VHarness, a unified framework driven by five atomic actions. We comprehensively evaluate VHarness across Image-to-HTML, Image-to-SVG, and Image-to-3D generation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that VHarness consistently improves visual fidelity and geometric accuracy across both text-only and multimodal coding agents. These findings highlight that modularizing visual reasoning into callable utilities provides a flexible and scalable foundation for future agentic coding systems.

papers.title: Learning Anisotropic Prediction Targets for Flow Models
papers.brief: AnisoFlow将固定预测目标改为可学习目标，在联合学习的基底中为各方向噪声分配非负权重。通过闭式映射精确恢复速度，无需修改架构、流匹配损失或采样器。
papers.tldr: 通过学习各方向的预测目标权重，提升流模型生成质量并减少低精度推理伪影。
papers.what_it_is: AnisoFlow将固定预测目标改为可学习目标，在联合学习的基底中为各方向噪声分配非负权重。通过闭式映射精确恢复速度，无需修改架构、流匹配损失或采样器。
key_points: 各向异性噪声加权：方向权重随数据方差近线性变化
ImageNet 256×256上FID由JiT的1.90降至1.55
改善速度恢复的条件性，大幅减少低精度推理的块间接缝
papers.why_notable: 仅学习预测目标就能改善生成质量，提供了独立于架构改造的优化路径；同时缓解低精度推理伪影，具有实际部署价值。
papers.abstract: Flow-based generative models are trained on a hand-chosen prediction target, such as the velocity, the noise, or the clean data. This choice strongly affects training and sample quality. We introduce Anisotropic Flow Models (AnisoFlow), which replaces a fixed prediction target with a fully learnable one. AnisoFlow learns to scale the noise component of the target anisotropically, assigning a separate nonnegative weight to each direction in a jointly learned basis. A closed-form map recovers the velocity from the network's prediction, leaving the architecture, flow-matching loss, and sampler unchanged. Since recovery is exact, training optimizes the target purely to make it easier for the network to predict. We theoretically analyze the resulting prediction error and predict that the preferred noise weight in each direction scales near-linearly with data variance, in agreement with the weights learned empirically in pixel space. AnisoFlow improves FID from 1.90 to 1.55 over the JiT baseline on ImageNet 256$\times$256, by learning only the prediction target, without representation alignment or architectural changes. In pixel-space text-to-image generation, AnisoFlow improves image quality and, through better-conditioned velocity recovery, largely removes patch-seam artifacts under reduced-precision inference.

papers.title: PaperCritic: Training AI Reviewers to Assess the Soundness of Papers
papers.brief: 该工作将审稿聚焦于论文论证是否可靠，构建带质量标签的审稿要点数据集，并以准确率和召回率的F1分数为奖励，通过强化学习训练PaperCritic。
papers.tldr: 用审稿意见质量与覆盖率联合奖励，训练可迁移到跨领域评审的论文审稿模型。
papers.what_it_is: 该工作将审稿聚焦于论文论证是否可靠，构建带质量标签的审稿要点数据集，并以准确率和召回率的F1分数为奖励，通过强化学习训练PaperCritic。
key_points: PaperSound-23K含1千篇ICLR投稿、2.3万条审稿要点
以要点可靠性、实质性及参考要点覆盖率计算F1奖励
域内优于前沿模型，并迁移至Nature论文及代码评审
papers.why_notable: 将主观审稿偏好与论证可靠性评估分离，为自动评审提供更明确的训练目标；跨领域迁移结果显示其可能学到通用的批判性评估能力。
papers.abstract: As AI conference submissions grow rapidly, AI reviewers are being considered as an alternative. However, simply imitating human reviewing is problematic because reviewing serves multiple purposes, including evaluating papers' soundness, interestingness, and clarity, the last two of which are subjective. In this work, we focus solely on evaluating soundness, the most important and objective criterion, and define the learning objective as jointly maximizing (1) precision, based on the soundness and substantiveness of review points, and (2) recall, the coverage of high-quality reference review points. Under this problem formulation, we construct a quality-labeled review point dataset, PaperSound-23K, using 1K ICLR submissions and 23K human-written and LLM-generated review points. Using this dataset, we train an AI reviewer model, PaperCritic, through reinforcement learning with the F1 score of precision and recall as the reward. Our experiments show that PaperCritic outperforms frontier models and models trained with other AI reviewer training methods on an in-domain test set. Surprisingly, learning to review ICLR submissions also transfers to reviewing Nature-family papers and even to out-of-domain reviewing tasks (e.g., code review, legal contract review, and feedback on story writing).

papers.title: V-JEPA-LM: Video-Language Models That Read Dynamics Beyond Static, Text-Aligned Representations
papers.brief: 将冻结的V-JEPA编码器接入语言模型，用像素变换生成答案均衡、仅动态变化不同的反事实视频，单阶段训练模型读取速度、方向和时序信息。
papers.tldr: 通过反事实视频监督，让语言模型读出预测式编码器中的动态信息并提升问答性能。
papers.what_it_is: 将冻结的V-JEPA编码器接入语言模型，用像素变换生成答案均衡、仅动态变化不同的反事实视频，单阶段训练模型读取速度、方向和时序信息。
key_points: V-JEPA动态信息位于跨视频共享子空间
单阶段训练453万样本，每帧32个视觉令牌
反事实监督平均提升4.5分，速度题提升38分
papers.why_notable: 以更少样本和视觉令牌在十一项视频基准各规模组领先；4B模型均分72.1，超过最佳开放8B模型的64.8。
papers.abstract: World-model video encoders such as V-JEPA learn how scenes change (direction, speed, order, state) from video alone. To answer questions, they are joined to a language model trained on captions and question-answer pairs. But each caption or question names only a few attributes of a clip, so the model learns to retrieve those attributes rather than to read the clip, and the dynamics the encoder carries go unused: on the same items, a linear probe reads speed from frozen V-JEPA features at 87% while the VLM answers at chance. We show where dynamics lives in a frozen encoder: in a subspace shared across videos for predictive encoders such as V-JEPA, but not as a shared component of frame-wise, text-aligned encoders such as SigLIP. We then build counterfactual supervision that makes the language model read it: pixel transformations turn public videos into answer-balanced variants whose answers are set by the transformation and differ only in the change. Trained in a single stage on 4.53M public samples with 32 visual tokens per frame, where open video LLMs use several stages, 9M to 172M samples and 64 to 256 tokens per frame on average, the resulting V-JEPA-LM models (1B to 8B, Qwen3 and Llama) lead every size class in average score across eleven video benchmarks; our 4B model scores 72.1, against 61.1 for the best open 4B and 64.8 for the best open 8B model. A controlled encoder x supervision study shows that the encoder decides what can be read and the supervision what is read: at a matched budget, counterfactual supervision adds 4.5 points on average and 38 on the speed questions of natural benchmarks. Code and models: https://github.com/kkt94/Llama-V-JEPA-LM.

papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) pose significant security risks by retaining private or hazardous information, creating an urgent need for unlearning techniques that excise specific knowledge without compromising general utility. However, prevailing fine-tuning-based unlearning methods struggle to achieve this balance, often suffering from computational inefficiency and unintended utility degradation due to the entangled nature of knowledge within model parameters. To disentangle forgetting from utility, we propose UUE, a theoretically grounded framework that reformulates unlearning as controllable model editing. First, UUE projects parameter updates into the orthogonal left null space of retained knowledge representations, strictly ensuring that the editing process causes minimal interference to the model's general capabilities. Second, distinct from targeted mapping, we introduce a convex untargeted objective that derives a closed-form analytical solution to effectively disrupt undesired knowledge by pushing forget-set embeddings toward their antipodal points. We implement UUE via lightweight, pluggable adapters (including a low-rank variant, UUE-L), enabling efficient deployment without modifying the frozen backbone. Extensive experiments on TOFU and WMDP benchmarks demonstrate that UUE and UUE-L achieve superior unlearning efficacy, significantly outperforming existing methods.

papers.title: Securing Multi-Agent Systems by Design
papers.brief: 提出响应操纵攻击ReMA，借助代理系统反馈迭代优化恶意响应；设计SecMAS聚合规则，依据语义相似度选择与足够多其他响应一致的结果。
papers.tldr: 通过迭代攻击与语义一致性聚合，为多智能体协作提供可证明的安全防御。
papers.what_it_is: 提出响应操纵攻击ReMA，借助代理系统反馈迭代优化恶意响应；设计SecMAS聚合规则，依据语义相似度选择与足够多其他响应一致的结果。
key_points: ReMA将定向与非定向响应操纵建模为优化问题
SecMAS按响应语义相似度筛选一致性结果

papers.why_notable: 把防御重点放在多智能体的结果聚合环节，同时给出理论保证与攻击验证，在维持任务效用的同时降低恶意成员的影响。
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems solve complex tasks by decomposing them into subtasks, delegating the subtasks to agents, and aggregating the agents' responses using an aggregation rule. Malicious agents can manipulate the final solution by providing malicious responses to their assigned subtasks. In this paper, we first propose response manipulation attacks (ReMA), which iteratively optimize malicious responses to maximize attack effectiveness. Specifically, we formulate untargeted and targeted attacks as optimization problems and develop an approach to approximately solve these problems by iteratively refining malicious responses based on feedback from a surrogate multi-agent system. To defend against such attacks, we further propose SecMAS, a secure aggregation rule that leverages the semantic similarities among agent responses to select the response that is most consistent with a sufficiently large subset of the other responses. We theoretically establish security guarantees for SecMAS against both untargeted and targeted attacks. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that existing aggregation rules are vulnerable to ReMA, whereas SecMAS effectively defends against all evaluated attacks, including adaptive variants of ReMA, while maintaining utility comparable to that of existing aggregation rules.

papers.title: Fuse-All MoE Inference Kernel with Load Balancing on TPUs
papers.brief: 提出面向TPU的融合推理内核，将令牌收集、专家投影、门控激活与输出写入合并，保留片上中间数据；再按预填充与解码阶段分别优化调度和专家布局。
papers.tldr: 通过融合计算与通信及专家负载均衡，提升TPU上的混合专家推理效率。
papers.what_it_is: 提出面向TPU的融合推理内核，将令牌收集、专家投影、门控激活与输出写入合并，保留片上中间数据；再按预填充与解码阶段分别优化调度和专家布局。
key_points: 固定令牌槽位，使调度与专家布局变化不影响路由语义

papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures activate only a subset of experts for each token, allowing large language models (LLMs) to scale parameter capacity without a proportional increase in computation per token. However, intermediate data movement and uneven expert loads limit the efficiency of MoE inference on TPUs. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce Fuse-All MoE, a TPU kernel design that jointly optimizes expert computation, output communication, and load balancing. The kernel fuses token collection, expert projections, gated activation, and output writes, retaining expert computation intermediates on chip. Fixed token-slot destinations allow scheduling and expert placement to change while preserving routing semantics. In prefill-decode (PD) disaggregated serving, Fuse-All MoE balances EP16 prefill workloads through scheduling and expert redistribution, while symmetric EP8TP2 shares active expert computation between the two TensorCore devices within each chip during decode. Our experiments show that Fuse-All MoE reduces kernel runtime for a measured skewed EP16 prefill workload from 2.3x to 1.09x the same fixed reference time for a balanced workload. Across 32-512 decode tokens, symmetric EP8TP2 reduces kernel latency by up to 21.3% relative to fused EP16. With accompanying serving stack optimizations, the integrated system improves serving throughput by up to 34.5% over the Megablox EP16 baseline.

papers.title: Antidistillation is Cheap: Lightweight Distillation-Resistance via Stylistic Corruption
papers.brief: 提出一种推理时防御，在恶意查询触发时向教师模型激活注入风格引导向量。通过定制并动态混合输出风格干扰学生学习，同时保持语义与流畅度。
papers.tldr: 通过向教师模型注入风格扰动，以极低开销阻碍竞争者蒸馏其能力
papers.what_it_is: 提出一种推理时防御，在恶意查询触发时向教师模型激活注入风格引导向量。通过定制并动态混合输出风格干扰学生学习，同时保持语义与流畅度。

动态混合防御风格，提高输出风格变化
实验显示蒸馏受阻，推理额外开销可忽略
papers.why_notable: 相比依赖代理模型操控采样的防御，该方法降低了部署开销，并在保持文本自然性的同时阻碍能力复制，适合商业模型接口保护。
papers.abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a highly effective paradigm for transferring capabilities from large language models (LLMs) to smaller, more specialized student models. In commercial deployment where frontier models are restricted behind black-box APIs, sequence-level distillation remains a potent vector for competitors to clone proprietary capabilities at a fraction of the development cost. Existing defenses mostly rely on surrogate models to manipulate next-token sampling, which increases computational overhead and real-time inference latency. In this work, we propose a lightweight defense that dynamically injects style-steering vectors into the teacher model's activations upon malicious queries. This framework offers exceptional flexibility, allowing hosts to customize target defensive styles and dynamically blend them to maximize stylistic variance. Crucially, this inference-time intervention preserves semantic utility and fluency during malicious queries, misleading adversaries into believing that they are extracting pristine teacher outputs, while standard consumers continue to receive original, unmodified responses. Our experiments demonstrate that this framework successfully disrupts student learning, achieving substantial anti-distillation performance while incurring negligible overhead and preserving text naturalness. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/distill-resist-38C6/.

papers.title: See Every Block Once: Variance-Reduced Post-Training for Masked Diffusion Language Models
papers.brief: 提出用于掩码扩散语言模型后训练的全块估计器，以分块ELBO作为替代目标。每个块恰好评估一次再取平均，避免随机抽块造成的重复与遗漏。
papers.tldr: 通过遍历全部生成块降低策略梯度估计方差，改善掩码扩散语言模型后训练。
papers.what_it_is: 提出用于掩码扩散语言模型后训练的全块估计器，以分块ELBO作为替代目标。每个块恰好评估一次再取平均，避免随机抽块造成的重复与遗漏。
key_points: 全块估计器逐块评估一次，随后平均结果
理论证明保持无偏，同样本量下消除块选择组间方差
五项基准中四项最优，较随机抽块平均提升12.79点
papers.why_notable: 改进直接针对扩散模型后训练的估计噪声，而非更换训练目标；理论降方差与数学、规划、代码任务上的收益相互印证。
papers.abstract: Policy gradient methods are widely used to align large language model outputs with human preferences, but the log-likelihoods they require cannot be directly computed in Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs). MDLM post-training therefore relies on a surrogate objective based on the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO), and recent work estimates a blockwise variant of this objective via Monte Carlo methods to support blockwise generation. However, existing estimation schemes randomly sample the block index, so they may evaluate the same block more than once and leave some blocks unevaluated. This introduces variance arising from block selection into the estimates. In this work, we propose a full-block estimator that evaluates every block exactly once and averages the results. We theoretically show that the proposed estimator remains unbiased while eliminating the between-group variance arising from block selection, thereby achieving lower variance than the baseline for the same sample size. In experiments on five benchmarks spanning mathematics, planning, and coding, our method achieves the highest accuracy on four benchmarks and outperforms the random block sampling baseline by an average of 12.79 points.

papers.title: Hierarchical Bayesian physics-augmented neural networks for populations of hyperelastic laws: specimen variability and uncertainty from scarce, noisy data
papers.brief: 将物理增强神经网络扩展为分层贝叶斯非线性混合效应模型，共享多凸特征并学习试样群体分布。通过变分推断联合估计特征、个体与群体，单独建模测量噪声。
papers.tldr: 分层贝叶斯物理增强网络从稀少噪声数据学习材料个体差异并预测新试样
papers.what_it_is: 将物理增强神经网络扩展为分层贝叶斯非线性混合效应模型，共享多凸特征并学习试样群体分布。通过变分推断联合估计特征、个体与群体，单独建模测量噪声。
key_points: 共享多凸特征，保证群体抽样所得本构律均多凸
新试样无需数据或仅凭部分测试即可预测可信区间
合成数据优于3种已发表方法，但低估未测试曲线不确定性
papers.why_notable: 将试样间真实差异与测量噪声分开，为少样本材料建模提供群体预测与不确定性量化；在橡胶和主动脉数据上达到确定性模型精度。
papers.abstract: The hyperelastic law of a material such as soft tissue differs between specimens, and often only a few specimens can be tested. Physics-augmented neural networks (PANNs) learn such laws from data without a prescribed functional form while keeping them physically admissible, and Bayesian versions of related models quantify the uncertainty of the law of one specimen or of a pooled group of specimens. A pooled fit, however, attributes the differences between specimens to measurement noise or to uncertainty about a mean law, and neither describes a new specimen. We first develop a Bayesian PANN for one specimen, whose priors keep the learned law plausible for few, noisy data. We then extend it to a hierarchical Bayesian PANN, a nonlinear mixed-effects model in which all specimens share learned polyconvex features and each specimen is a draw from a population of laws. Features, specimens, and population are inferred jointly by variational inference, with a separate model of the measurement noise, so that the variability between specimens is not mistaken for noise, the population carries its own uncertainty, and every specimen drawn from it is polyconvex. The population predicts the response of new specimens with credible intervals, without data or from a partial test, and assigns them to cohorts with quantified uncertainty, all without a prescribed form of the law. On synthetic populations, it recovers the population from few specimens and predicts new specimens more reliably than three published methods. On Treloar's rubber and on healthy and aneurysmal aortas, it reaches the accuracy of a deterministic PANN and assigns no aorta specimen to the wrong cohort with confidence, although it underestimates the uncertainty of untested curves.

papers.title: Quantum Graph Neural Networks: Architectures, Trainability, and Applications
papers.brief: 这篇综述用编码器、图条件量子电路、观测量及可选经典预测头统一描述量子图网络，并按五类架构比较资源成本、对称性与实验证据，提出最低报告规范。

papers.what_it_is: 这篇综述用编码器、图条件量子电路、观测量及可选经典预测头统一描述量子图网络，并按五类架构比较资源成本、对称性与实验证据，提出最低报告规范。

papers.abstract: Quantum graph neural networks (QGNNs) apply parametrized quantum circuits to graph-structured data, with the aim of overcoming limits of classical graph neural networks in scalability, expressivity, and long-range information flow. Since the first Hamiltonian-based model in 2019, the field has produced many architectures, applications, and claims, but the evidence behind them has not been assessed systematically. This survey introduces a unified formalism that describes every QGNN as an encoder, a graph-conditioned circuit, observables, and an optional classical head, together with a circuit-level condition for permutation equivariance and a resource model for comparing costs. We organize the literature into five architecture families (convolutional, equivariant, message-passing and recurrent, Hamiltonian, and hybrid) and compare them by qubit cost, symmetry, scalability, and evidence. We then review symmetry and geometric inductive biases (permutation, rotation, and Lorentz), the results on expressivity, trainability, noise, and scalability, and applications in high-energy physics, chemistry, finance, healthcare, earth observation, and transportation. An audit of datasets and evaluation practices leads to a minimum reporting protocol. Our main finding is that the design space is rich and symmetry is the best-supported inductive bias, whereas the evidence remains thin: results are mostly simulated, on small graphs, at parity with classical models or with fewer parameters, and no advantage has yet been established on tasks over classical graph data. We identify five open challenges and a research agenda covering provable advantage, equivariant and geometric designs, fault-tolerant implementations, and shared benchmarks. The coverage extends through 2026 and emphasizes recent work.

papers.title: From Local Prediction Error to Final Outputs: A Theory of Expert Sharing in Multi-Step Reasoning
papers.brief: 研究跨层或跨步骤共享专家的收益何时能传递到最终输出。通过线性回归推导共享准则，并结合误差传播分析、端到端界与受控实验检验。
papers.tldr: 专家共享虽能降低局部误差，却可能放大多步推理的最终输出风险。
papers.what_it_is: 研究跨层或跨步骤共享专家的收益何时能传递到最终输出。通过线性回归推导共享准则，并结合误差传播分析、端到端界与受控实验检验。
key_points: 线性回归中精确权衡共享的方差收益与角色偏差
固定线性传播下保留误差方向与相关性，构造风险反转

papers.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models can share experts across layers or computational steps, pooling training information from different contexts. This can reduce local prediction error, but multi-step systems are ultimately evaluated by their final outputs. We study when these local gains survive composition. In specified linear regression models, we derive exact sharing and merging criteria by balancing variance savings against bias from sharing across roles with different target behavior. Under a common fixed linear propagation map, we characterize expected squared final-output risk, retaining error directions and correlations. We construct cases where sharing lowers average local error yet increases final-output error. Within this setting, we also identify when orthogonal full pooling with isotropic noise preserves every local improvement at the final output. For general routed computations, we derive conditional end-to-end error bounds that account for distribution shifts, errors in surrounding components, and changes in expert selection. Separately, we show that correct predictions and route labels alone do not establish that individual experts implement the attributed operations. Controlled experiments realize a strict local-to-final risk reversal. In low-data symbolic settings, trained Transformers exhibit statistically supported teacher-forced one-step gains without statistically resolved free-running final-output gains. Separate intervention tests distinguish successful multi-layer actions from single-expert attribution and generalization to unseen transitions. Together, these results distinguish when sharing improves local estimation, when those gains survive to the final output, and what evidence is needed to attribute reusable operations to individual experts.

papers.title: Protection-Oriented Assessment of Machine Learning-Based Fault Detection in Power Systems
papers.brief: 研究对三类机器学习检测器与序电流基准进行保护导向评估。通过因果窗口标注、事件分组交叉验证和固定安全预算选阈值，比较漏跳、误跳及检测时延。

papers.what_it_is: 研究对三类机器学习检测器与序电流基准进行保护导向评估。通过因果窗口标注、事件分组交叉验证和固定安全预算选阈值，比较漏跳、误跳及检测时延。

papers.abstract: Machine learning (ML)-based fault detectors are increasingly proposed for power system protection, yet aggregate metrics can obscure the consequences of false and missed trips. We present a protection-oriented assessment of three ML detectors and a sequence-current reference on PROTECT-90, comprising 9,022 simulated fault episodes on a 90 kV double-circuit line. The assessment combines five window conditions, causal window-end labelling, episode-grouped cross-validation, and operating-point selection under a fixed security budget. It reports security, dependability, detection timing, decision margins, and episode-level nuisance assertions. Gradient-boosted trees, a convolutional neural network, and logistic regression achieve AUC-ROC values above 0.999, yet at a security budget of $10^{-3}$ their developed-fault missed-trip rates range from 0.007% to 1.99%. Post-clearing false-trip rates of approximately 0.12-0.16% per window coexist with nuisance assertions in 11.3-19.1% of episodes. Among the analysed physical descriptors, missed trips are most consistently associated with higher fault resistance within the sampled range. An analytical current proxy suggests a fault-current gradient only partly reproduced by waveform-derived current (rank correlation 0.62). No single topology state or faulted phase consistently dominates within the sampled domain. Because PROTECT-90 contains fault episodes only, security is assessed on pre-fault and post-clearing windows rather than independent non-fault disturbances.

papers.brief: 提出面向异质工业时序的联邦异常检测流程：通过过程挖掘比较本地数据与全局参考的相似性，据此动态加权本地模型并下发个性化更新。
papers.tldr: 用过程挖掘衡量节点差异并加权聚合，改善工业物联网联邦异常检测。
papers.what_it_is: 提出面向异质工业时序的联邦异常检测流程：通过过程挖掘比较本地数据与全局参考的相似性，据此动态加权本地模型并下发个性化更新。
key_points: 过程挖掘提供节点相似性，驱动动态加权聚合
F1较本地训练和FedAvg分别提升46.52%、11.99%
误报较标准联邦聚合相对减少51.24%
papers.why_notable: 将过程层面的相似性用于联邦聚合，针对不同工况下的非独立同分布数据降低误报，为工业监测的个性化建模提供可验证路径。
papers.abstract: While federated anomaly detection enables the integration of local data insights across diverse nodes to reduce false positives, it inherently struggles with non-IID data. In practice, industrial IoT plants often operate under varying conditions and experience diverse environmental phenomena, resulting in significant heterogeneity in the monitored time series. In such settings, standard federated learning approaches fail to perform nuanced aggregation that accounts for these cross-node differences, ultimately leading to increased false positive rates. In this paper, we propose a process mining approach to evaluate the similarity of local node data against a reference provided by a global node. The global node utilizes these similarity metrics to dynamically weight local models during aggregation, producing personalized updates distributed across the network. We evaluate our approach using industrial IoT time-series data collected from manufacturing plants operating under distinct conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that our process mining-enabled federated anomaly detection pipeline achieves superior performance, yielding a 46.52% and 11.99% relative improvement in F1-score compared to isolated local training baselines and standard FedAvg, respectively, alongside a 51.24% relative reduction in false positives over standard federated aggregation.

papers.title: Electrocardiographic Imaging via Posterior Sampling under Operator Discrepancy
papers.brief: 提出扩散后验采样方法 OpDis-PS，学习前向算子偏差与心脏信号的关系并修正算子，在不同算子条件下使用固定先验重建心脏表面电势。
papers.tldr: 通过建模信号相关的前向算子偏差，提升心电成像在身体条件变化下的重建精度。
papers.what_it_is: 提出扩散后验采样方法 OpDis-PS，学习前向算子偏差与心脏信号的关系并修正算子，在不同算子条件下使用固定先验重建心脏表面电势。
key_points: OpDis-PS 建模信号相关偏差，而非独立噪声
测试肺电导率变化与新增皮下脂肪层两类偏差
优于经典正则化和学习预测器，未见病理收益最大
papers.why_notable: 将身体条件引起的系统性偏差纳入重建过程，比假设算子准确更贴近实际；在未见心脏病理上的收益显示其泛化潜力。
papers.abstract: Electrocardiographic imaging (ECGI) reconstructs heart-surface potentials from body-surface potentials, an ill-posed inverse problem. Diffusion posterior samplers combine a learned prior with an explicit forward operator that they assume to be accurate. In ECGI this operator is only an estimate, because the body changes with respiration and posture, and body composition such as subcutaneous fat is rarely known for an individual patient. The resulting operator discrepancy is structured and depends on the heart signal. We introduce OpDis-PS, a diffusion posterior sampler that models this discrepancy instead of treating it as signal-independent noise. OpDis-PS learns how the discrepancy depends on the signal, folds this into a corrected forward operator, and reconstructs with a fixed prior across all operator conditions. We study two realistic sources of discrepancy, changing lung conductivity and an added subcutaneous-fat layer. Across both, OpDis-PS reconstructs more accurately than classical regularization and learned predictors, with its largest gains on held-out cardiac pathologies.

papers.tldr: 融合视觉、声音与语言，模型无需身份标签即可从少量观测中识别人员。
papers.what_it_is: 该模型用中国餐馆过程构建非参数贝叶斯生成模型，自动推断人员概念数量；融合经CLIP、CLAP提取及PCA降维的多模态特征，适应观测条件变化。
key_points: 中国餐馆过程支持无身份标签学习与人数推断
6名参与者、8种条件下平均识别准确率0.89
已在丰田Human Support Robot上演示
papers.why_notable: 无需预先给定人数，准确率仍接近已知人数的聚类基线；即使概念数量推断不准，也能保持人员识别能力，为机器人个性化服务提供支持。
papers.abstract: Service robots in domestic and office environments must identify users to provide personalized services based on their preferences and previous interactions. This is challenging because only a few observations may be available for learning, while observation conditions change owing to appearance, environmental noise, and utterance content. To address this challenge, this study proposes a multimodal person concept model that learns person concepts from a small number of observations, without person labels, and enables robust identification under changing conditions. The model employs a nonparametric Bayesian generative model based on the Chinese restaurant process and integrates visual, acoustic, and linguistic features extracted using Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) and Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP), followed by principal component analysis (PCA). We evaluated six participants under eight conditions in which appearance changes, additive noise, and transcription errors were introduced individually and in combination. Averaged over the eight conditions, the proposed model achieved an identification accuracy of 0.89 while inferring the number of person concepts from the observations, which is comparable to k-means clustering that was supplied with the true number of participants (0.88). We also examined PCA dimensionality, modality availability, and variation strength, and demonstrated the model on a Toyota Human Support Robot. These results show that multimodal person concept learning supports robust person identification under changing conditions, and that identification can succeed even when the number of concepts is not correctly recovered. The project page and demonstration video are available at https://okitamisan01.github.io/person_concept/.

papers.title: Federated Physics-Informed Thermal Field Prediction Across Unseen Geometries in Distributed Additive Manufacturing
papers.brief: 提出Fed-PIGANO，各制造站点本地训练物理信息几何感知神经算子，再聚合几何编码器与预测网络，在不共享零件几何的条件下预测新设计热场。
papers.tldr: 联邦物理信息模型无需共享零件几何，即可准确预测未见设计的热场。
papers.what_it_is: 提出Fed-PIGANO，各制造站点本地训练物理信息几何感知神经算子，再聚合几何编码器与预测网络，在不共享零件几何的条件下预测新设计热场。
key_points: 二维稳态热基准含5类多边形、3个站点及4种分布场景
7次重复实验中，12组场景站点平均相对L2误差为1.83%至2.04%
精度接近集中训练，PDE残差持续低于本地训练
papers.why_notable: 在几何数据无法集中共享时，仍能获得接近集中训练的跨几何预测精度，为分布式制造中的形状优化和逆向设计提供支撑。
papers.abstract: In additive manufacturing (AM), each change in part geometry requires a new thermal simulation, which makes design evaluation over many candidates costly. Geometry-aware models reduce this cost by predicting thermal fields on unseen parts with a single learned model, but they assume that diverse geometries are available centrally. This assumption is restrictive when each manufacturing site holds only a limited set of proprietary part designs that it cannot share. We propose Fed-PIGANO, a federated framework that trains physics-informed geometry-aware neural operator (PI-GANO) models at individual sites and aggregates their geometry encoders and prediction networks without sharing part geometries. We evaluate the framework on a 2D steady-state thermal benchmark for metal AM, with geometries from five polygonal families distributed across three sites under four scenarios that range from identical to strongly different family compositions. Over seven replications, Fed-PIGANO achieves mean relative L2 errors of 1.83% to 2.04% across all 12 scenario-site cases, compared with up to 20.46% for local-only training, and consistently yields lower PDE residuals. Its prediction accuracy is comparable to that of a centralized model trained on the pooled geometries of all sites. These results demonstrate that federated learning lets manufacturing sites benefit from each other's geometries without sharing them, enabling rapid thermal prediction on new part designs for tasks such as shape optimization, inverse design, and uncertainty quantification.

papers.title: Direction or Magnitude? Learning Scalars over Task-Calibrated Directions
papers.brief: SCALAR从任务激活构建固定输入基，为各输入方向配置随机输出字典，仅训练逐层标量系数。通过分组计算与跨层字典共享，减少训练及固定基存储开销。
papers.tldr: SCALAR仅学习任务校准方向上的标量，以更少参数实现接近LoRA的微调效果。
papers.what_it_is: SCALAR从任务激活构建固定输入基，为各输入方向配置随机输出字典，仅训练逐层标量系数。通过分组计算与跨层字典共享，减少训练及固定基存储开销。
key_points: 固定任务激活输入基与随机输出字典，仅学习逐层标量
常识推理效果接近LoRA，可训练参数约为其4%
Qwen2.5-7B峰值训练显存降20%，吞吐升6%
papers.why_notable: 它表明固定任务相关方向、仅调整幅度也能有效适配模型，并同时压缩可训练状态与显存需求，为资源受限微调提供实用途径。
papers.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) aims to preserve adaptation quality while reducing training costs. We propose SCALAR, which achieves performance comparable to LoRA with substantially fewer trainable parameters, lower peak training memory, and higher throughput. SCALAR constructs a fixed input basis from task activations and assigns a random output dictionary to each input direction. Fine-tuning learns only layer-specific scalar coefficients, reducing gradient and optimizer-state storage. Grouped computation aggregates output atoms before applying the adapter to token activations, while dictionary sharing across compatible layers reduces fixed-basis storage. Experiments on commonsense reasoning, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge evaluation after instruction tuning demonstrate effective adaptation at small trainable budgets. On commonsense reasoning, SCALAR achieves accuracy comparable to LoRA with about 4% of its trainable parameters. System measurements on Qwen2.5-7B show 20% lower peak training memory and 6% higher throughput than LoRA. The combination of adaptation quality, a compact trainable state, and training efficiency makes SCALAR a promising approach to resource-constrained fine-tuning.

papers.title: Beyond Prediction Gain: LASR as a Metric for Action-Grounded Latents in World Models
papers.brief: 提出无量纲指标LASR，衡量潜变量相对当前状态及非动作替代信息的额外动作预测支持。以记录动作和物理状态变化为目标，构建统一离线评估协议。
papers.tldr: 提出离线指标，区分世界模型潜变量中的真实动作信息与预测捷径。
papers.what_it_is: 提出无量纲指标LASR，衡量潜变量相对当前状态及非动作替代信息的额外动作预测支持。以记录动作和物理状态变化为目标，构建统一离线评估协议。
key_points: GeoLASR衡量典型支持，WorstLASR定位最弱情形
采用回合隔离划分、统一预测器及正负对照
机器人操作与匹配多任务实验验证，并训练审计残差适配器
papers.why_notable: 将预测能力提升与动作信息贡献区分开，为无动作标注视频学习的潜变量提供更有针对性的评估，也支持表示比较与训练审计。
papers.abstract: World models that support planning, control, and interpretable reasoning require latent representations that genuinely encode action. Yet the large-scale video data from which such models are learned overwhelmingly lack action annotations. Latent-action models infer action-like variables from observation sequences, enabling action-aware learning from unlabeled videos or trajectories. A fundamental concern, however, remains: a latent that improves future prediction may simply encode the current state, episode progress, task identity, or other predictive shortcuts. Existing evaluation practices---reconstruction loss, rollout fidelity, action recovery, or downstream performance---cannot isolate this distinction. We introduce the Latent Action Support Ratio (LASR), a dimensionless metric that measures, under offline evaluation on held-out data, whether a learned latent provides predictive support for action-related targets beyond the current state and non-action alternatives. LASR provides two complementary summaries: GeoLASR captures typical support, while WorstLASR identifies the weakest case. We instantiate the LASR benchmark with recorded actions and corresponding physical state changes as targets, episode-held-out splits, one predictor type for all comparisons, and positive and negative controls. Experiments on recorded robot manipulation data and a matched multi-task panel demonstrate that LASR detects known action information, rejects representative non-action shortcuts, and enables graded comparisons among imperfect latent representations. We further use LASR to train and audit a lightweight residual adapter, obtaining descriptively better point estimates whose uncertainty is assessed with paired comparisons. LASR thus provides a principled offline protocol for measuring action-related predictive support in world-model latents.

papers.title: Activation Steering the Nan-Shan in Typhoon
papers.brief: 作品以康拉德小说为种子，让语言模型持续回馈自身输出，形成视听装置。研究采用激活引导及新提出的自适应方法，调节长程生成中的叙事节奏与离题行为。
papers.tldr: 通过自适应激活引导调控语言模型的循环生成，探索叙事失控与可控性的边界。
papers.what_it_is: 作品以康拉德小说为种子，让语言模型持续回馈自身输出，形成视听装置。研究采用激活引导及新提出的自适应方法，调节长程生成中的叙事节奏与离题行为。
key_points: 以康拉德原文为种子，循环输入模型自身输出
引入自适应激活引导，调控长程叙事与离题
观察叙事偏离、指令泄露式文本及不连贯沉思
papers.why_notable: 将模型内部干预用于生成艺术，呈现长程文本调控的有效性与不可预测性，为审视人工智能可解释性和控制边界提供独特案例。
papers.abstract: Typhoon is an audiovisual installation based on Joseph Conrad's novella, in which Captain MacWhirr steers the steamer Nan-Shan directly into and through a catastrophic storm. The novella is a study of what happens when the scale of a phenomenon exceeds the practical and conceptual frameworks available to comprehend it and of the paralysis that sometimes follows a demand for action in such overwhelming circumstances. We chose the text of Typhoon to reflect on human culture's current AI moment. We prompt a large language model, seeded with Conrad's original language, to feed endlessly on its own output, and explore when and how the text becomes increasingly alien and unwieldy as time progresses, including deviations from the narrative, digressions into the model's own instructions and thinking, and long periods of incoherent rumination. We employ methods from activation steering, including a novel adaptive steering method we introduce, to control the rhythm of the narrative and the model's digressions over long stretches of generation. The simultaneous efficacy and unpredictability of this steering showcases the tension between the perceived interpretability of AI, and the reality of a system that remains outside our comprehension and control.

papers.title: Efficient Genotype Classification from 3D MRI in ADPKD via Density-Aware Point Sampling and E(3)-invariance
papers.brief: E3PN将三维MRI转为点表示，从双肾混合分布中采样以降低显存开销，并通过坐标规范化引入E(3)不变性，提升小样本下的基因型分类效率。
papers.tldr: 将三维肾脏影像转为稀疏点集，以几何不变性低成本推断多囊肾基因型。
papers.what_it_is: E3PN将三维MRI转为点表示，从双肾混合分布中采样以降低显存开销，并通过坐标规范化引入E(3)不变性，提升小样本下的基因型分类效率。
key_points: 双肾混合分布点采样，替代高开销体素表示
坐标规范化实现E(3)不变性，提升数据效率
较3D ResNet训练快163倍、显存少103倍
papers.why_notable: 建立三维MRI五分类基因型首个基准，F1由0.165升至0.226；以有限精度增益换来两个数量级的效率提升。
papers.abstract: Early detection of genetic kidney diseases, especially autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD), is crucial because certain genotypes such as truncating PKD1 mutations cause rapid kidney growth and early progression to end-stage kidney disease. MRI-based genotype inference is a potential low-cost complement to genetic testing. However, although many deep learning methods have been developed for classifying various MR images, applying them to ADPKD remains challenging: (1) abdominal MR images are generally too large to be handled by deep learning models designed for smaller images like brain MRI, and (2) the amount of labeled data for ADPKD genetic mutations is insufficient to train deep learning models. In order to address these challenges, we propose E3PN, an efficient 3D MRI-based ADPKD genotype classification network that relies on point sampling and E(3)-invariance. We utilize a point representation of 3D MRI, which consumes less GPU memory than a voxel representation. For further memory efficiency, 3D points are sampled from a mixture distribution over the two kidneys in each image. Since E(3)-invariance has been shown to improve data efficiency, we also incorporate it into our model through coordinate canonicalization. On our ADPKD dataset, E3PN trains 163 times faster and uses 103x less GPU memory than a 3D ResNet, while also improving F1 from 0.165 to 0.226 over both baselines. These results establish a first benchmark for five-way ADPKD genotype classification from 3D MRI and show that point sampling and coordinate canonicalization yield two-orders-of-magnitude efficiency gains with a modest but consistent improvement in F1.

papers.title: Complex Schrödinger Bridges
papers.brief: 提出共形最优传输，在几何提升下刻画复空间中的几何与耗散动力学。基于此构建复薛定谔桥，将缩放、旋转规律作为扩散任务的几何先验。
papers.tldr: 以共形几何先验构建复值扩散桥，连接图像转换与量子逻辑门模拟
papers.what_it_is: 提出共形最优传输，在几何提升下刻画复空间中的几何与耗散动力学。基于此构建复薛定谔桥，将缩放、旋转规律作为扩散任务的几何先验。
key_points: 共形最优传输（COT）建模复值物理系统
图像到图像桥I²CSB采用解析螺旋后验
物理约束CSB在量子电动力学中模拟逻辑门
papers.why_notable: 将物理系统的缩放与旋转结构纳入扩散桥，为复值数据建模提供几何约束；解析后验也为图像转换中的可扩展计算提供路径。
papers.abstract: Diffusion bridges have emerged as versatile frameworks for facilitating transformations between arbitrary data distributions. However, these approaches are hindered by an immense optimization space and its underlying high-order structures. This paper explores a variant of diffusion bridges for solving real-world problems in complex vector spaces governed by scaling and rotation laws, such as Hamiltonian structures. To address this, we introduce conformal optimal transport (COT), a complex-valued transportation framework designed for physical systems with geometric and dissipative dynamics under a geometric lifting. Building on this, we propose a new class of dynamical diffusion bridges, called complex Schrödinger bridges (CSBs), whose derived algorithms can handle diffusion-based tasks using a conformal geometric prior. For scalability, we propose image-to-image CSB (I$^2$CSB), a tractable diffusion-bridge technique with an analytic spiral posterior. Finally, we implement a physics-informed CSB algorithm within simulations of quantum electrodynamics, mimicking the logical behavior of quantum logic gates. Our extensive results validate the underlying theory while highlighting advantages of complex-valued diffusion.

papers.title: The Polyak-Łojasiewicz Paper: A 10-Year Retrospective
papers.brief: 这是一篇关于PL条件的十年回顾，追溯原论文的形成与命名过程。作者借助AI精炼主定理，并梳理相关批评、关联概念及后续扩展。
papers.tldr: 十年回顾梳理PL条件的来龙去脉，并精炼核心定理、回应批评与讨论扩展。
papers.what_it_is: 这是一篇关于PL条件的十年回顾，追溯原论文的形成与命名过程。作者借助AI精炼主定理，并梳理相关批评、关联概念及后续扩展。
key_points: 回顾2016年引入PL条件名称的原论文
提供AI辅助精炼的主定理版本
梳理PL条件相关批评、关联思想与扩展
papers.why_notable: 原论文获2026年ECML PKDD时间检验奖；这篇回顾有助于理解PL条件的理论定位及其长期影响。
papers.abstract: In 2016, we wrote a paper introducing the phrase "Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) condition" for an old idea, unsure of how readers would react. The paper ultimately had a larger impact than we expected, and we are surprised and honoured to receive the 2026 PKDD ECML Test of Time Award. With 10 years of hindsight, this note offers an informal and candid retrospective on the PL condition. We take a look back at the origins of the paper, give an AI-assisted refined version of the main theorem, review criticisms of the work, and discuss a variety of related ideas and extensions.

papers.title: RaFL: An Empirical Study of Random Filter Losses for Image Reconstruction
papers.brief: RaFL通过随机卷积、傅里叶特征和小波滤波比较预测与目标，并用梯度范数匹配自动平衡损失；每步重采样滤波权重，采用高斯初始化。
papers.tldr: 随机滤波损失无需预训练特征与手动调权，以低开销改善二维和三维图像重建。
papers.what_it_is: RaFL通过随机卷积、傅里叶特征和小波滤波比较预测与目标，并用梯度范数匹配自动平衡损失；每步重采样滤波权重，采用高斯初始化。
key_points: 融合三类随机滤波器，以梯度范数匹配自动调权
评估3个二维、2个三维任务：3项优于像素损失，2项持平
前向FLOPs增量低于2%，损失计算量为VGG19的1/182
papers.why_notable: 将感知损失对预训练特征的依赖替换为随机滤波，在五项任务上表现稳定，且不增加推理成本，为跨域重建提供轻量损失选择。
papers.abstract: Pixel losses train image reconstruction networks toward a point statistic of the target distribution, often averaging away fine textures under uncertainty. Perceptual losses alleviate this issue using pretrained features, but those features are inherently domain-specific. We study a random filter loss (RaFL) that compares prediction and target through filters with random weights, avoiding both pretrained features and task-specific loss engineering. RaFL combines random convolutions, random Fourier features, and random wavelet filters, automatically balancing their contributions through gradient-norm matching, eliminating manual loss-weight tuning and grid search. We systematically investigate three design choices: filter family, weight resampling schedule, and weight initialization. Based on validation PSNR and stability across random seeds, we select the configuration that uses all three filter families, redraws filters every optimization step, and employs Gaussian initialization. We evaluate RaFL on three 2D and two 3D image reconstruction tasks. RaFL outperforms a pixel loss on three tasks and matches it on two, and demonstrates stable performance across random seeds on all five tasks. RaFL adds less than 2% to the backbone's forward FLOPs and no inference cost, requiring $182\times$ fewer loss FLOPs than a VGG19 perceptual loss. These findings suggest that RaFL is a simple, tuning-free, and domain-agnostic loss objective for 2D and 3D image reconstruction.

papers.title: Representational Geometry as a Diagnostic for Adversarial Robustness
papers.brief: 研究在MNIST上比较三种对抗训练与普通训练的多层感知机。用M-PHATE追踪跨训练轮次的表征几何，并量化干净与扰动样本的表征差异。
papers.tldr: 对抗准确率与表征稳定性可能给出相反排名，潜在几何可补充鲁棒性审计。
papers.what_it_is: 研究在MNIST上比较三种对抗训练与普通训练的多层感知机。用M-PHATE追踪跨训练轮次的表征几何，并量化干净与扰动样本的表征差异。
key_points: MNIST多层感知机：比较三种对抗训练方案与普通训练
M-PHATE可视化样本表征随训练轮次的几何变化
倒数第二层测量位移、最大均值差异与近邻恢复
papers.why_notable: 结果揭示攻击下准确率与内部表征稳定性并不一致，为鲁棒性审计提供互补诊断视角，避免仅凭单一指标排序防御。
papers.abstract: Adversarial training is a common technique for making neural networks more robust to small, intentionally crafted input perturbations, and robustness is commonly measured through accuracy under attack. By exploring inter-network representations across different adversarial training objectives, we can analyze whether multiple networks organize their latent representations similarly. We study Multilayer Perceptrons trained on MNIST under three adversarial training regimes and compare the resulting population training dynamics and geometry to those of a vanilla network. We use M-PHATE to embed data samples across training epochs and examine how the geometry of the data changes during training under adversarial objectives. On penultimate-layer representations we measure displacement between clean and perturbed points, distributional distance through maximum mean discrepancy, and nearest-neighbor recovery. Our visualizations and quantitative analyses show that adversarial training leads to structural changes in how networks organize internal data representations, and robust accuracy and representational stability can rank the same defenses in opposite ways. These findings support a discussion of re-evaluating how practitioners approach the auditing of model robustness by treating latent representations and their training trajectories as diagnostic artifacts across sets of networks.

papers.title: Pattern-Based Matrix Analysis Under Permutations
papers.brief: 提出模式距离，衡量矩阵经最优行列重排后与指定几何模式的接近程度。以线性指派子问题交替优化，并结合低秩残差构建模式加低秩分解。
papers.tldr: 通过行列重排识别矩阵几何结构，并结合低秩残差统一刻画矩阵简洁性。
papers.what_it_is: 提出模式距离，衡量矩阵经最优行列重排后与指定几何模式的接近程度。以线性指派子问题交替优化，并结合低秩残差构建模式加低秩分解。
key_points: 重排优化一般为NP难，采用线性指派交替求解
同参数预算下分解仍有增益，随机掩码对照显著削弱增益
验证覆盖合成恢复、相关矩阵、图邻接及注意力头
papers.why_notable: 为低秩之外的矩阵简洁性提供统一度量与求解框架，将潜在排序、社区检测和带宽最小化等问题联系起来。
papers.abstract: Low-rank approximation captures one important notion of matrix simplicity: a matrix is simple if it is well described by a low-dimensional linear model. This paper studies a complementary notion. We consider matrices that become structurally simple only after permuting rows and columns, so that their mass concentrates in a prescribed geometric pattern such as a band, block-diagonal, arrowhead, or related form. We introduce a pattern distance that measures how close a matrix is to a given pattern after optimal reordering, giving a common framework for structural problems such as latent ordering, community detection, and bandwidth minimization. The problem is NP-hard in general; we derive an alternating algorithm based on Linear Assignment subproblems. We further introduce a pattern-plus-low-rank decomposition that combines permutation-structured fitting with a low-rank residual, whose permutation step is pattern fitting on the residual; its gains across pattern families persist at a matched parameter budget and are substantially reduced under a density-matched random-mask control. We evaluate the framework on synthetic recovery tasks, real correlation and graph adjacency matrices, and transformer attention heads, showing that a single universal algorithm recovers qualitatively different forms of matrix structure.

papers.title: Provable Cross-Modal Transfer of Hierarchical Concept Structure in CLIP Embeddings
papers.brief: 将概念层级形式化为层级角度分离（HAS），在固定图像、仅训练文本嵌入的模型中，证明图文共现结构如何驱动层级结构跨模态迁移。
papers.tldr: 理论证明对比学习可将图像侧已有的概念层级结构迁移至文本嵌入。
papers.what_it_is: 将概念层级形式化为层级角度分离（HAS），在固定图像、仅训练文本嵌入的模型中，证明图文共现结构如何驱动层级结构跨模态迁移。
key_points: HAS在原始图像及随机初始化图像嵌入中近似成立
全局最优时，文本HAS违例率受图像违例及近违例率约束
线性对比损失有闭式解；InfoNCE在充分正则化下获类似保证
papers.why_notable: 为非层级训练目标产生语义层级提供理论解释，并揭示图像与文本侧的结构不对称，帮助理解对比表征的来源。
papers.abstract: Contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP are trained to align images and text, not to represent taxonomies. Yet empirical studies show that CLIP embeddings exhibit hierarchical structure aligned with the hierarchy of semantic concepts. A theoretical characterization of why such hierarchy emerges from a non-hierarchical objective remains open. In this paper, we formalize this phenomenon as Hierarchical Angular Separation (HAS), a geometric property whereby each non-leaf concept embedding is more similar to its descendants than to off-branch concepts. Empirically, we show that HAS holds approximately in raw images and randomly initialized CLIP image embeddings, while in text embeddings it holds approximately only after contrastive learning. To theoretically explain this asymmetry, we analyze an unconstrained features model in which the image embeddings are fixed and only the text embeddings are trained. At the global minimizer, the text-side HAS violation percentage at each node is at most the image-side HAS violation and near-violation percentage. The key mechanism is the hierarchical co-occurrence structure of image-text pairs, which biases text embeddings toward root-centered image prototypes. For a linear contrastive loss, we derive a closed-form solution that makes this mechanism explicit. We extend the analysis to the InfoNCE loss and establish analogous guarantees under sufficient regularization. Synthetic experiments validate the theory and show that HAS is transferred even beyond the regimes covered by our analysis.

papers.title: AmbiSteer: Selectively Eliciting Ambiguity-Aware Responses in Vision-Language Models
papers.brief: AmbiSteer在推理时结合提示与激活引导，促使视觉语言模型澄清歧义或列举候选对象；再用线性分类器判断输入歧义，按需调整引导方向。
papers.tldr: 通过歧义分类器选择性引导视觉语言模型，改善澄清与直接回答的切换。
papers.what_it_is: AmbiSteer在推理时结合提示与激活引导，促使视觉语言模型澄清歧义或列举候选对象；再用线性分类器判断输入歧义，按需调整引导方向。
key_points: 在3个视觉语言模型上，单独激活引导效果有限且依赖模型
提示结合激活引导增加澄清行为，但也误触发无歧义输入
线性分类器条件化引导，使恰当处理率从59.0%升至77.0%
papers.why_notable: 价值在于把不确定性表达从统一触发改为按输入选择，既减少歧义场景下的武断回答，也避免清晰问题被过度澄清。
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often exhibit overconfidence, providing firm answers even when visual evidence is insufficient. A prominent case is referential ambiguity in Visual Question Answering (VQA), where multiple entities in an image are plausible referents of a question. Addressing such cases requires recognizing when ambiguity is present: ambiguous questions can be handled by asking for clarification or enumerating plausible referents, while unambiguous questions should receive a direct answer. Current VLMs struggle with this distinction, often defaulting to a single interpretation. To investigate whether activation steering can serve as an inference-time mechanism to elicit such behaviors, we introduce AmbiSteer, a lightweight framework to selectively elicit ambiguity-aware behavior. Across three VLMs, we find that steering alone has limited and model-dependent effects, while prompting is generally more effective. Combining prompting and steering substantially increases clarification and enumeration behaviors, but also elicits them on unambiguous cases. AmbiSteer addresses this using a linear classifier to predict input ambiguity and condition the steering direction accordingly, increasing the proportion of inputs handled appropriately from 59.0% to 77.0% on average across models. Our work sets the ground for lightweight approaches to reduce model overconfidence in uncertain multimodal settings.

papers.title: UltraBERT-JEV: Encoder models for System One Applications
papers.brief: 研究以UltraBERT-380M为每个选项设置一个掩码，比较四种评分与概率归一化微调方案，无需生成文本即可决策；辅助头同步预测支持答案的句子。
papers.tldr: 编码器单次前向完成选项决策，比小型生成模型更准更快，并同步预测支持证据。
papers.what_it_is: 研究以UltraBERT-380M为每个选项设置一个掩码，比较四种评分与概率归一化微调方案，无需生成文本即可决策；辅助头同步预测支持答案的句子。
key_points: 同数据训练，准确率69.7%至72.1%，高于Qwen的67.6%
“yes减no”评分使外部准确率从57.8%升至59.6%
A100单请求耗时29毫秒，对照为68毫秒；峰值显存更高
papers.why_notable: 表明小型编码器在固定选项任务上可兼顾准确率与低延迟，并输出支持证据，为不需要文本生成的决策应用提供替代路线。
papers.abstract: We study encoder models that pick one of several options in a single forward pass, without generating text. This technical report compares recipes for fine-tuning UltraBERT-380M with one mask per option. The four recipes differ in how an option is scored and how the scores become probabilities; one follows the expert gate of DeepSeek-V3. Trained on the same data as Qwen3-0.6B with the LLM-as-Jev recipe (67.6% test accuracy), the encoder reaches 69.7% to 72.1%. Scoring an option by "yes" minus "no" instead of "yes" alone gives the larger gain, from 69.7% to 71.3% on the test set and from 57.8% to 59.6% on external benchmarks (56.1% for the decoder). Sigmoid normalisation adds 0.8 test points; a square-root softplus adds none. One request at a time on an NVIDIA A100, the encoder takes 29 ms per decision against 68 ms, but uses more peak memory (2.8 against 2.2 GiB). An auxiliary head, trained on human-marked evidence and on labels selected with a reward adapted from SelfCite, predicts in the same pass the sentences annotated as support for the answer.

papers.title: Is Abliteration Getting Harder? Not Uniformly: Refusal Removal by Direction-Based Ablation and ARA in Heretic on the Qwen3.8, Gemma 4, Olmo 3.1 and Mistral Small 3.2 LLMs Versus Their Predecessors
papers.brief: 研究在Heretic 2.0中对五组新旧模型实施方向消融与ARA权重编辑，统一提示、搜索预算和散度约束，以有害提示上的残留拒答率比较移除难度。
papers.tldr: 五组模型对比显示，拒答移除难度并未随版本升级统一增加，而取决于方法与预算。
papers.what_it_is: 研究在Heretic 2.0中对五组新旧模型实施方向消融与ARA权重编辑，统一提示、搜索预算和散度约束，以有害提示上的残留拒答率比较移除难度。
key_points: WildGuard评判972条留出有害提示的残留拒答。
新版拒答率变化：方向法−1至+37，ARA−26至+34个百分点。
Gemma方向消融的难度增幅在公共提示集上反转。
papers.why_notable: 结果挑战新版模型更难移除拒答的笼统判断，说明安全审计需跨模型、方法和提示来源比较，预算变化也可能改变结论。
papers.abstract: Abliteration, a fine-tuning-free weight edit, removes refusal from open-weight large language models (LLMs). The developer of Arbitrary-Rank Ablation (ARA), an optimisation-based variant, reports that direction-based abliteration, which ablates a refusal direction, increasingly fails on newer models. On five release pairs, refusal removal did not become uniformly harder. Qwen2.5-32B and Qwen3.8-27B, Gemma-2-27B and Gemma-4-31B, OLMo-2-32B and Olmo-3.1-32B, Mistral-Small-2409 and Mistral-Small-3.2, and Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3.5-4B were edited in Heretic 2.0 by three or four direction-based methods (difference-in-means, MPOA, SOM and, on the small pair, J-space) and ARA under the same prompts, nominal search budget, first-token KL divergence cap and selection rule; removal counted as harder when the automatic WildGuard judge found more of 972 held-out harmful prompts (JailbreakBench, XSTest, StrongREJECT, HarmBench and an author-compiled malicious-code bank) still refused. After direction-based removal, newer releases retained -1 to +37 percentage points more refusal, and after ARA -26 to +34. With run-to-run variance included, between-pair heterogeneity of the direction-based effect ranged from high to low with the scale and variance model (I^2 20-80%). ARA lost less effectiveness than direction-based methods in Gemma and OLMo and more in Qwen; each verdict rests on one ARA run, and some changed with the divergence budget or variance model. In Gemma the direction-based increase came from the malicious-code bank and reversed on public sets. Contrary to prediction, keyword counts at the tool's window did not undercount judged refusal on average, but differed by a mean 7 points per model. Audits of a single pair, method or prompt source can reach opposite conclusions. Whether a newer model resisted removal depended on the release pair, method and budget, not on generation alone.

papers.title: BLiMP-RO: A Benchmark of Linguistic Minimal Pairs for Romanian
papers.brief: 构建覆盖罗马尼亚语多类语法现象、经母语者验证的最小句对基准，并从零训练GPT-2与GPT-BERT，比较有限输入下的数据与架构效应。
papers.tldr: 罗马尼亚语最小对基准揭示数据规模、来源与架构对语法泛化的影响
papers.what_it_is: 构建覆盖罗马尼亚语多类语法现象、经母语者验证的最小句对基准，并从零训练GPT-2与GPT-BERT，比较有限输入下的数据与架构效应。
key_points: 覆盖10个领域、50种语法现象，共6435个句对
新增1000万词儿童视频字幕语料，数据每增十倍准确率约升9个百分点
同规模下BabyBabelLM通常更优，GPT-BERT持续优于GPT-2
papers.why_notable: 为罗马尼亚语提供经人工验证的细粒度语法评测，并用受控训练比较数据量、语料来源与模型架构的作用。
papers.abstract: Evaluating grammatical knowledge in language models requires benchmarks that cover diverse linguistic phenomena and are validated against human judgments. We introduce BLiMP-RO, a Romanian minimal-pair benchmark covering 50 grammatical phenomena across ten domains. It comprises 493 linguist-constructed sentence pairs, evaluated by native speakers in five experiments, and 5,942 additional semi-automatically generated, human-validated pairs. We further investigate grammatical generalization under limited linguistic input by training GPT-2 and GPT-BERT models from scratch on Romanian BabyBabelLM data and a newly collected corpus of 10 million words from child-targeted video captions. Increasing caption training data yields approximately 9 percentage points of accuracy improvement per tenfold increase in corpus size. At matched data sizes, BabyBabelLM generally outperforms video captions, while GPT-BERT consistently outperforms GPT-2. Our findings highlight how training data quantity, composition, and model architecture shape grammatical generalization in Romanian.

papers.title: G-CAST: Governed Continual Self-Training for E-Commerce Agents under Evolving Demands
papers.brief: G-CAST将每日生产证据转为按奖励路由、熵优先级组织的训练数据，并受控更新奖励。通过累积评估把关模型版本切换，兼顾新行为学习与旧能力保留。
papers.tldr: 通过受控持续自训练，让电商智能体适应需求与工具变化并保留既有能力。
papers.what_it_is: G-CAST将每日生产证据转为按奖励路由、熵优先级组织的训练数据，并受控更新奖励。通过累积评估把关模型版本切换，兼顾新行为学习与旧能力保留。
key_points: 奖励路由与熵优先级联合组织生产训练数据
受控奖励演化与累积评估约束模型更新
已部署于阿里1688的B2B采购智能体源采
papers.why_notable: 真实生产实验显示，相比强自主后训练基线，该系统更好适应新需求并保留旧行为，为持续更新商业智能体提供落地路径。
papers.abstract: With the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), an increasing number of users are turning to LLM-powered agents for conversational shopping in e-commerce. However, the user needs continue to change as new product categories, procurement scenarios, and feature requests emerge. At the same time, the product's execution harness-including its tools, skills, and operating procedures-continues to evolve to support increasingly sophisticated interactions. These changes create two practical challenges: 1) Demand drift alters the distribution, intent, and complexity of user requests, causing a model trained once to fall behind; 2) Harness evolution requires the model to use newly introduced capabilities correctly without losing behavior that users already rely on. Periodic manual retraining is too delayed and labor-intensive for this setting. To address these challenges, we present G-CAST, a governed continual self-training system that converts daily production evidence under evolving demand and capability contracts into reward-routed, entropy-prioritized training data and governed reward evolution. Governed checkpoint transition under cumulative evaluation controls each model update, enabling the agent to learn newly introduced behaviors without sacrificing previously accepted capabilities. Experiments on a real production e-commerce agent show that G-CAST achieves stronger adaptation to newly introduced demand while better preserving previously accepted behavior compared with a strong autonomous post-training baseline. Ablations further show that both reward-routed, entropy-prioritized data orchestration and governed reward evolution are important to these gains. G-CAST is now deployed in Yuancai(http://cai.1688.com/), a B2B procurement agent on Alibaba's 1688 platform.

papers.title: AI Reviews Are Biased Towards the Appendix
papers.brief: 研究分析四个会议的两千篇论文，追踪大模型与人类评审所提缺陷来自正文还是附录，并比较不同模型访问方式下的批评来源分布。
papers.tldr: 研究发现大模型审稿过度关注附录细节，与人类评审的批评重心明显偏离。
papers.what_it_is: 研究分析四个会议的两千篇论文，追踪大模型与人类评审所提缺陷来自正文还是附录，并比较不同模型访问方式下的批评来源分布。
key_points: 覆盖ACL、EMNLP、COLM、ICLR共2000篇论文
GPT与Claude约50%或更多缺陷来自附录，人类仅8.4%
附录偏向在API、编程智能体及网页访问中均存在
papers.why_notable: 揭示模型审稿可能把非核心技术细节放大为论文缺陷，为评估自动审稿质量提供了比人机意见一致性更具体的观察维度。
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by reviewers to highlight weaknesses during the reviewing process, and their outputs often shape the reviews that humans submit. Prior work studies how LLM reviews align with human ones, yet we know little about which parts of a paper these models actually criticize. In this work, we investigate 2,000 papers from ACL, EMNLP, COLM, and ICLR, and show that the latest GPT and Claude models draw about 50% or more of their review weaknesses from the appendix. This behavior holds across the API, coding-agent, and web access methods for using LLMs to review a paper. In contrast, we find that humans draw only 8.4% of their weaknesses from the appendix, and these weaknesses primarily revolve around a paper's presentation and content related to its core idea. Meanwhile, LLMs draw weaknesses from deep in the appendix that concern fine-grained technical details not central to the paper's contributions. We anticipate that our analysis will contribute to the scholarly discourse on AI reviews. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/cincynlp/review_appendix.

papers.title: RAG-FGO: Dynamic Optimization of Query-Rewriting Agents for Generative RAG
papers.brief: RAG-FGO将查询改写建模为离散与连续混合空间中的黑盒优化，联合调整提示模板和解码参数，并用全局搜索、局部扰动及记忆池迭代改进策略。
papers.tldr: 通过全局搜索与局部扰动动态优化查询改写智能体，提升生成式检索的效果与稳定性。
papers.what_it_is: RAG-FGO将查询改写建模为离散与连续混合空间中的黑盒优化，联合调整提示模板和解码参数，并用全局搜索、局部扰动及记忆池迭代改进策略。
key_points: 黑盒优化联合搜索离散提示模板与连续解码参数
全局搜索跳出局部最优，局部扰动精细调整
精英保留记忆池积累优质策略，缓解反馈噪声
papers.why_notable: 把查询改写从静态规则转为可迭代优化的策略，兼顾混合参数搜索与噪声鲁棒性，为复杂语义检索提供实用优化路径。
papers.abstract: In retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), query rewriting serves as a core interface that aligns user intent with external knowledge bases, and its effectiveness directly determines overall system performance. However, generative retrieval faces three critical challenges in real-world deployment: noisy retrieval feedback, the difficulty of jointly optimizing discrete prompt templates and continuous decoding-control parameters, and the limited generalization of static rewriting strategies under semantically complex scenarios. To address these issues, we propose RAG-FGO, a dynamic optimization framework for generative retrieval strategies. RAG-FGO formulates query rewriting as a non-differentiable black-box optimization problem in a mixed discrete-continuous space, and represents prompt templates and decoding parameters as adaptively optimizable query-rewriting agents. The framework performs global search to enable semantic jumps and structural reorganization that escape local optima, while applying local perturbations for fine-grained alignment and precise refinement. In addition, RAG-FGO introduces an elite-preserving memory pool that accumulates high-quality strategies across iterations, thereby mitigating the impact of stochasticity and noisy feedback on optimization stability. Experimental results on a diverse suite of benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method, supporting its applicability to complex semantic retrieval tasks.

papers.title: Superfluid: Local AI Server for Distributed LLM Inference
papers.brief: Superfluid以统一调度整合本地与跨设备大模型推理，优先响应交互请求。实验显著降低首令牌延迟、提升吞吐，并在设备动态加入与故障时保持请求不丢失。
papers.tldr: Superfluid以统一调度整合本地与跨设备大模型推理，优先响应交互请求。实验显著降低首令牌延迟、提升吞吐，并在设备动态加入与故障时保持请求不丢失。
papers.abstract: Running large language models (LLMs) on local devices keeps data private, removes per-token cost, cuts network latency, and keeps working without a connection. Two shifts now strain how such models are served. On one device, several agents share a locally served model with an interactive user. Across devices, a developer or small team often owns several capable machines from different vendors, which sit idle most of the day because every local server serves one runtime on one machine. We present Superfluid, an open-source LLM server built for local inference at both scales. On one device, Superfluid drives llama.cpp, MLX, or BaseRT in isolated worker processes through one scheduler that moves interactive requests ahead of agent work, computes a prompt shared by many requests once, and writes every token to a durable log before it reaches the client. Across devices, one Superfluid server turns a fleet of machines into a single API endpoint. Machines with different hardware serve copies of the same model, receive work according to their measured speed, and can join or fail under load without losing a request. For Qwen3.8-27B on an Apple M5 Pro, a chat sent while eight agents are working receives its first token in 1.5 s, against 291-612 s on llama-server, Ollama, and mlx_lm.server. On six machines from three chip vendors serving 64 simulated users for one hour, Superfluid answers all 5,041 requests while machines join one at a time and one is killed and rejoins; throughput grows from 112 to 534 tok/s and the median first-token time falls from 99 to 12 s. On twelve Mac Studio M3 Ultras it sustains 10,656 tok/s across 38,563 requests from 384 agents without a failure. Superfluid is available under the Apache-2.0 licence at https://github.com/basecompute/superfluid.

papers.title: What Do Multilingual Self-Supervised Speech Encoders Know About Sentence Meaning?
papers.brief: 通过跨模态检索探测76种语言的语音编码器，发现句义可被线性解码但语言间差异显著；扩模偏益高资源语言，语音识别微调增强语义却削弱跨语言通用性。
papers.tldr: 通过跨模态检索探测76种语言的语音编码器，发现句义可被线性解码但语言间差异显著；扩模偏益高资源语言，语音识别微调增强语义却削弱跨语言通用性。
papers.abstract: Self-supervised speech models (S3Ms) have been scaled up to thousands of languages and millions of hours of audio, yet little is known about how these models structure semantic knowledge across languages. In this work, we probe sentence-level semantics in massively multilingual S3Ms across 76 languages, using linear maps from frozen speech representations into a frozen text embedding space, evaluated by cross-modal retrieval. Sentence meaning is linearly accessible but highly uneven across languages and resource tiers. Cross-lingual probes can match language-specific probes on languages never seen in probe training, but per-model monolingual decodability does not predict transfer. Within the OmniASR wav2vec family, scaling from 300M--7B disproportionately benefits high-resource languages, and ASR tuning sharply improves semantic decodability while making representations more language-specific. However, semantic content is entangled with acoustics, inflating apparent performance on single-speaker corpora.

papers.title: Cracks in Embeddings: Robustness and Stability of JEPA-Based Chest X-Ray Representations
papers.brief: 评测四种JEPA胸片编码器，发现攻击与图像扰动可显著损害表征及分类性能；对抗微调有效改善鲁棒性，而仅用干净数据训练的向量量化方法反而退化。
papers.tldr: 评测四种JEPA胸片编码器，发现攻击与图像扰动可显著损害表征及分类性能；对抗微调有效改善鲁棒性，而仅用干净数据训练的向量量化方法反而退化。
papers.abstract: Self-supervised Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) models are increasingly used for medical imaging, however there is a limited understanding about robustness of these models toward real-world image changes. We test four JEPA-based chest X-ray encoders, trained on 78,468 NIH ChestX-ray14 images, under six tests: two black-box adversarial attacks (SPSA, Boundary Attack), three image corruptions (Gaussian noise, brightness shift, contrast shift), and a label-scarcity test, measuring embedding change and classification AUROC. These perturbations cause severe, model-dependent damage: encoder-level Cosine Similarity drops as low as 0.33, and AUROC falls by as much as 0.12 in the worst case (I-JEPA under the Boundary Test). We test two ways of training the small predictor on top of each frozen encoder to address this. Adversarial fine-tuning, trained on clean and perturbed images together, raises embedding consistency above 0.97 in nearly every case and improves AUROC, relative to the same perturbed baseline, for most models, with the largest gain of $+0.10$ on I-JEPA. A Vector-Quantized codebook method, trained only on clean images and evaluated on perturbed test images for the first time, instead degrades under distortion for all four models, most noticeably for I-JEPA ($-0.15$ AUROC on average), showing that its discrete bottleneck alone does not provide the robustness that comes from training on perturbed data directly.

papers.title: Zoom In, Scale Out: Metric Depth Models Mistake Digital Zoom for Moving Closer
papers.brief: 提出无标签数字变焦测试，揭示单目深度模型常将放大误判为靠近，根源在相机参数估计；无需训练的校正及自一致性微调可显著缓解。
papers.tldr: 提出无标签数字变焦测试，揭示单目深度模型常将放大误判为靠近，根源在相机参数估计；无需训练的校正及自一致性微调可显著缓解。
papers.abstract: Many new AI models estimate how far away things are, in metres, from a single photo. To do this they must also work out what camera took the photo.
